title: Data & Analytics
tagline: Grounded answers, reliable SQL, and numbers you can trust.
description: Prompt for analysis you can stake a decision on: structured extraction, step-by-step reasoning, SQL grounded in your real schema, and answers that refuse to guess.

nodes.title: Give the model your data's meaning
nodes.summary: A schema shows column names, not meaning. Units, time zones, soft-deleted rows, and business definitions ('active user', 'revenue') have to be stated, or the model will compute something plausible and wrong.
points: State units (cents vs. dollars) and time zones.
Mention filters that always apply, such as excluding test accounts.
Ask for the query only, then run it and sanity-check the result yourself.
